BEFORE YOU BUILD

The finer details.

Can I preview the wheel inside my car?+

The prototype combines an interactive 3D wheel with nine photographic concept interiors. Each interior represents a brand; accurate model-specific scans and fitment data will be used in production.

Which materials can I customize?+

Try twill carbon, forged carbon or leather for the rim, then choose leather or Alcantara grips, stitching colors, a center marker and optional upgrades.

Can I place an order from this preview?+

This is a design prototype. You can save, share and download your configuration; it does not send an order or collect payment. Production pricing and fitment need RPM Customs approval.
